meta.population: 50 items / 171 condition records (full corpus, no sampling)

rules.normalization: regex [a-z0-9]+ over lowercased text; keep len>=5; drop STOPWORDS; no stemming
rules.stopwords: fixed set in helper source (function words + single letters + contraction fragments)
rules.df_universe: presence across items in pre-final turn texts, 50-item universe
rules.ordered_pairs: X!=Y ordered; target Y-assistant only; source X-USER turns only
rules.tie_ordering: stable sort keeps corpus order on ties
rules.top5: first 5 after descending max-overlap ordering, REVIEW queue with no-verdict caveat
rules.R-REF1: this/these + token(len>=4) in A; that/those excluded (relative-pronoun dominant)
rules.R-REF2: rare token (len>=5, df<=2) in Y-assistant, absent Y-user + prompt, present X-user
rules.R-STANCE/R-LEN: descriptive only; token-tolerance verdict OPEN (no tokenizer profile)

limits: lexical screens miss semantic adjacency (DU004 screen values bound the screen, not the item)
no extrapolation from examples to corpus totals
no KEEP/REVISE/REJECT decisions; proposed REVIEW = human-queue only
